notes.title: Big News: Madness Arena is Going Free-to-Play + AI Bots Are Here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181296/dd4205f5642d419fb4200ee217d23b20fc70882b.png[/img]

Hey Players,

We’ve got some exciting updates to share with you!

We’re Going Free-to-Play!
That’s right—Madness Arena is now free for everyone to jump in and enjoy. We want to grow the community and make it easier than ever for new players to join the fun.

For those of you who bought the full game: thank you so much for your support. If you find any characters locked, don’t worry—we’ve got your back. Just shoot us an email at gamedev@dreamchasers-interactive.com, and we’ll send you a code to unlock the full characters DLC for free.

AI Bots Are Here!
We know it can be frustrating if you’re ready to play but can’t find an online match. That’s why we’ve added AI Bots to the game! Whether you’re playing solo or waiting for others to join, you can now battle it out with smart, challenging AI opponents whenever you want.

This is a big step for Madness Arena, and it’s all about making the game more fun and accessible for you. Thanks for sticking with us—your support means the world.

See you in the arena!
The Madness Arena Team

notes.title: Madness Arena - Early Access
notes.notes:
Note: Madness Arena is currently still a game under going many changes and development, and many features are still in development, including boss fights, equipment shops, new maps, and various quality-of-life improvements. We invite all players to join and support us in this journey by purchasing the game, playing it, and sharing constructive feedbacks.

Welcome to the stealth launch of Madness Arena, an exhilarating peer-to-peer PVPVE experience for up to 16 players (starting with 8 players). The game features a unique blend of anime-inspired art set against semi-realistic environments, enhanced with dynamic manga-style effects. Our primary focus is on delivering a fun and chaotic experience.

In the coming months and years, we plan to continuously expand the game with new characters (10+ characters every quarter planned), exciting features, and much more. We invite you to be part of this adventure as we strive to create one of the most mind blowing game ever, built with passion by gamers for gamers. Let's rock the world together!
